ios.desc:
A brand-new WeatherBug is here!

The weather app you rely on for live local radar, severe storm alerts, lightning alerts and pollen forecasts, now with a new design, an improved experience and even more ways to stay ahead of the weather.

Whether you’re planning your day, tracking a storm, checking your UV exposure, or wondering when the rain will start, WeatherBug gives you the weather information you need when you need it.

Explore new and improved features, including UV, Spark Lightning, Tropical Center, Precipitation Outlook and more, all designed to make understanding what’s happening outside easier and more useful.

Plan ahead with 10-Day Forecasts and over 140 hours of Hourly Forecasts, track changing conditions with interactive weather maps, and get timely severe weather alerts when conditions could impact your day.

WeatherBug brings your forecast, radar, lightning, severe weather, pollen, precipitation and more together in one easy-to-use app.

Because checking the weather shouldn’t just tell you what’s happening. It should help you know what to do next.

Join millions of people who use WeatherBug to stay informed, prepared and ready for whatever the weather brings.

WEATHERBUG FEATURES:

YOUR WEATHER FORECAST
• Real-Time Pinpoint Forecasts: Get the most accurate current, hourly, and 10-day weather forecasts
• Precipitation Outlook: See when rain or snow is likely to start and stop near you
• Enhanced Interactive Map: Visualize weather conditions with over 20 weather maps
• Lifestyle Forecasts: Know how the weather will impact your trips, workouts, allergies, chronic pain and much more
• Weather Widget: Customize your alerts and display them with weather widgets
• Severe Weather Alerts: Get alerted to thunderstorms, tornadoes, flooding and other severe weather near you
• Weather Videos: Get storm updates, weather explainers, seasonal outlooks, and practical safety tips from WeatherBug meteorologists to help you understand what’s happening and what it means for you.

TRACK ANY CONDITION
• Live Weather Radar: available across the U.S.
• Spark Lightning Alerts: track lightning near you with minute-by-minute, mile-by-mile lightning proximity alerts, ideal for outdoor sports, golf, pools and hiking
• Tropical Center: track hurricanes and tropical storms with forecasts and changing conditions
• Fire Center: global fire data to know when you are at risk
• Winter Weather: Stay safe in severe winter conditions with our real-time snowstorm alerts

MORE THA

quotes.text:
I have used the WeatherBug app [1] on my most recent three or four Android phones. It provides tabs for the current conditions, hourly and 10-day forecasts, and a radar map.

They also have a website [2] and an IOS app [3]. I haven't used either of these.

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aws.android

[2] https://www.weatherbug.com/

[3] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/weatherbug-weather-forecast/id281940292
